plusPaywallTerms: Parlance Plus is a monthly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

It renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in Google Play subscriptions.

waitingText:
Write in your practice language, then tap Feedback.

Parlance splits it into sentences, infers CEFR level, and shows coaching here.
assessedLevelText: This sentence is at approximately {level} level.
assessedLevelRichText: Inferred around {level} on the CEFR scale — the grammar and vocabulary in this sentence fit that band.
assessedLevelHint: Inferred CEFR level for this sentence
promptLabel: Writing ideas — respond to one in your target language
pastEntriesEmpty: Your saved entries will show up here.
analyzingParlanceOnDevice: Parlance Coach is analyzing… First on-device run can take 1–2 minutes while the model loads.
analyzingParlanceServer: Parlance Coach is analyzing… First server run may take a few minutes.
writeFirst: Write at least one paragraph first.
offline: You're offline — writing is saved locally, but cloud AI feedback requires a connection.
privacyLoadError: Unable to load the privacy policy. Try again later.

authSetupHint: Sign in to use cloud AI without API keys.
authSetupHintNative: Sign in with Apple or Google to use cloud AI without API keys.
authSetupHintWeb: Sign in to use cloud AI without API keys (Groq, Gemini, …).
deleteAccountLead: This permanently deletes your account. It cannot be undone.
deleteAccountItemAuth: Your Parlance sign-in (Apple or Google) is removed.
deleteAccountItemUsage: Your cloud AI usage counter is erased.
deleteAccountItemPacks: Any remaining call pack balance is erased and is not refundable.
deleteAccountItemPlus: Your Parlance Plus record is erased. Cancel the subscription separately in your Apple Account settings so it stops billing.
deleteAccountItemJournal: Your journal entries stay on this device. Delete them from Past Entries if you want them gone.
deleteAccountDone: Your account and Parlance data were deleted.
authCloudNote: Cloud providers use your Parlance account — no API key needed.
corsWarning: This provider may block direct browser requests due to CORS restrictions. If analysis fails, try Groq, OpenAI, or Gemini — they all support browser access.
guideComingSoon: Guide coming soon for this language.
waitingParlanceOnDevice: {icon} Parlance Coach runs on this device. Tap Feedback to analyze. The first run may take 1–2 minutes while the model loads.
waitingParlanceLang: {icon} Parlance Coach does not cover this Write language yet.
waitingParlanceInstalling: {icon} Parlance Coach is finishing install on this phone. Keep the app open.
waitingParlanceNotInstalled: {icon} Parlance Coach is not on this phone yet. Update from Play internal testing and keep the app open while the models finish installing.
waitingParlanceMissing: {icon} Parlance Coach — model not in this build. Re-archive after preparing models, or switch provider in AI settings.
waitingParlanceServer: {icon} Parlance Coach — on your Mac run the Parlance SLM server, or use the iOS app build with bundled models.
waitingWebLLM: {icon} Browser AI — first use downloads ~380 MB (cached after). Or switch to a cloud API for instant feedback.
waitingSetupProvider: Set up an AI provider to get feedback. Groq is free.
waitingAddKey: Add your {name} API key to enable feedback.
waitingCloudReady: {icon} {name} — cloud AI via your Parlance account. Write to get feedback.
waitingCoachFallback: {icon} Parlance Coach will handle this on-device. It is smaller than the cloud model, so double-check anything it marks correct.
coachFallbackOffline: Offline — the on-device coach analyzed this instead.
coachFallbackQuota: Free cloud calls used up. The on-device coach analyzed this instead.
coachFallbackSignedOut: Sign in for cloud AI. The on-device coach analyzed this instead.
coachWriteMismatch: This looks like {detected}. Write is set to {write}. Switch Write to match, then tap Feedback again.
errCloudTimeout: Cloud AI via Parlance account timed out. Try again or switch provider in AI settings.
errWebgpuUnavailable: WebGPU is not available in your browser. Please use Chrome 113+ or Edge 113+, or switch to a cloud provider in AI settings.
errParlanceStillWorking: Parlance Coach is still working. The first on-device run can take 1–2 minutes while the model loads — keep the app open and wait, or try a shorter sentence.
errParlanceTimeout: Parlance Coach timed out. Check that the dev server is running, or switch provider in AI settings.
errProviderTimeout: {name} timed out. Check your connection or try another provider in AI settings.
errParlanceNotBundled: Parlance Coach model is not bundled in this build. Re-archive after preparing models, or use another provider in AI settings.
errParlanceLang: Parlance Coach does not cover this Write language yet.
errParlanceInstalling: Parlance Coach is still installing on this phone. Keep the app open and try again in a minute.
errParlanceNotInstalled: Parlance Coach is not on this phone yet. Update from Play internal testing and keep the app open while the models finish installing.
errWebgpuBrowser: Your browser does not support WebGPU (needed for Browser AI). Switch to a cloud provider like Groq (free) in AI settings.
errNoApiKey: No {name} API key. Add one in AI settings.
errMonthlyLimit: Monthly limit reached (30 calls). Get 100 more calls for $0.99 in the app.
errPurchaseFailed: Purchase failed: {err}. You can try again or switch to Parlance Coach in Settings.
